acceptedScope: One renderer-neutral align relationship between two existing semantic Scene entities through the typed command and reversible history path.

validation.workflow: PASS: 11/16 gates, zero violations, scene-authoring-breadth active

observations: A stable dbx:relation ID and existing source/target entity IDs are required.
Only x, y, and center alignment axes are accepted; duplicate, self, unknown, stale, malformed, and unsupported command inputs fail closed.
Relationship serialization is deterministic and backward-compatible for Scenes that do not declare relationships.
Undo and redo restore relationship state with monotonic revisions while preserving entity identity, kind, geometry, display metadata, lock state, and ordering.

live authoring, Stage 12 acceptance, or Ready-to-Play
